_comment: Machine-readable index of the TRRs in this folder. Each entry's fields mirror tired-labs/techniques index.json (name, id, tactics, contributors, external_ids, platforms, procedures, pub_date, last_update, tests). NOTE: upstream index.json is a BARE top-level ARRAY of these entry objects; this file wraps them in {_comment, trrs:[]} and adds a local 'path' field for convenience. When contributing upstream, emit the entry into the top-level array and drop the wrapper and 'path'. 'id' values are local placeholders until a maintainer assigns the upstream ID (upstream reserves TRR0001 for its example report and real TRRs start higher, so the number here will be reassigned on contribution).
